query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `users` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `openId` varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `name` text,
  `email` varchar(320),
  `loginMethod` varchar(64),
  `discordId` varchar(64) UNIQUE,
  `studentId` varchar(100),
  `profileCompleted` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `rank` enum('Comandante Geral','Subcomandante Geral','Coronel','Tenente-Coronel','Major','Capitão','1º Tenente','2º Tenente','Subtenente','Cabo','Soldado'),
  `role` enum('member','instructor','admin') DEFAULT 'member' NOT NULL,
  `approvalStatus` enum('pending','approved','rejected') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `lastSignedIn` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
